name: Collect and validate booking requests from a webhook form

parameters.content:
## Collect and validate booking requests from a webhook form

### How it works
1. A webhook receives a booking request; fields are validated and the lead time is computed.
2. Invalid requests are logged with the exact reason and answered with a 422 your form can show inline.
3. Slots outside the 2-hour to 60-day booking policy get a structured decline.
4. A 30-minute duplicate guard answers repeated submissions as success without booking twice.
5. Fresh requests are booked, a WhatsApp confirmation is prepared and sent, and the form gets a 200.

### Setup steps
- Import into n8n, open the webhook node and use its test or production URL in your form action.
- Replace the two replace-me nodes with your calendar write and your WhatsApp, SMS or email send node.
- Point the error log at a sheet if you want to monitor failing form fields.

### Requirements
n8n on any plan. The demo run needs no credentials; production needs a calendar credential plus a messaging credential.

### Customization
The booking policy (2 hours to 60 days), the duplicate window (30 minutes) and all copy are plain settings in the named nodes. The pinned webhook data uses a far-future slot so the policy decline path runs on execute.

Built by Vlotstroom. Free no-show and waitlist calculators: https://vlotstroom.github.io/noshow-calculator/

## 1. Receive + validate
Webhook accepts POST from any form. Every field is validated and the lead time computed; rejected requests are logged, then answered 422. Out-of-policy slots get a structured decline.

## 2. Dedup + book
A static-data guard flags repeat submissions from the same phone within 30 minutes. Duplicates get an idempotent response; fresh requests go to your calendar node.

## 3. Confirm + respond
Confirmation copy is built, sent through your channel, and the form receives a 200 with the booking status.
